Chapter 1051: 8 Renowned (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3

Chapter 1051: Chapter 8 Renowned (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3

“Hmm, let’s go inside and talk.”

Lord Qingfen nodded and then walked into the Sky Burning Court alongside Lin Yuan.

“I didn’t expect your Fierce Sun bloodline to be so rich…”

Inside the Sky Burning Court, Lord Qingfen looked at Lin Yuan with a sigh and said.

“Fierce Sun bloodline?” Lin Yuan’s heart stirred, and he immediately realized that Lord Qingfen must have attributed his strength to the Fierce Sun bloodline.

As for the so-called Fierce Sun bloodline, Lin Yuan had learned much from the countless ancient texts and traditions within the Sky Burning Court.

Thinking of this, Lin Yuan immediately felt no need to explain too much.

Everything could be attributed to the Fierce Sun bloodline.

“I’m not sure either, it’s just that the more I cultivate, the easier it seems to be.”

Lin Yuan said at once.

“Your case of atavism midway through is naturally different from those core royals who are cultivated from a young age.” Lord Qingfen shook his head and said.

Even within the royal family of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, having a bloodline concentration reach the core level was extremely rare. Cases like Lin Yuan’s, where the intense increase in bloodline concentration occurred through atavism, had only a few precedents since the existence of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan followed Lord Qingfen’s words.

…

“What do you plan to do in the future?”

Lord Qingfen looked at Lin Yuan and inquired.

“What does Master think I should do?”

Lin Yuan immediately threw the question back.

“Your bloodline concentration has reached the level of the core royal family. In theory, you should head to the capital as soon as possible and integrate into the royal family.”

Lord Qingfen paused for a moment before continuing, “But you have no foundation within the royal family; returning rashly is not a good thing.”

“Not a good thing?”

Lin Yuan immediately understood.

Even within the royal family, there are disputes and factions.

Lin Yuan’s Fierce Sun bloodline had reached a core level, but he did not originate from any main royal lineage. Returning suddenly would be too complicated.

Like a prince from the common folk returning to the palace wanting to inherit the throne? It certainly wouldn’t be so smooth.

“So I suggest you stay in Qingfen City, and wait until you step into the realm of the Great Lord, then return to the capital.”

Lord Qingfen said.

A core royal of the Great Lord realm, their combat power is terrifyingly strong. Going back at that time would at least give you the power to protect yourself.

“Then I’ll follow Master’s advice.” Lin Yuan immediately responded.

In fact, Lin Yuan also didn’t want to integrate into the so-called royal family because he did not rely on the Fierce Sun bloodline to reach his current strength.

Returning to the capital and integrating into the royal family would likely necessitate a bloodline concentration check.

At that time, Lin Yuan would surely be exposed.

Therefore.

If Lord Qingfen were to let Lin Yuan return to the capital.

Then, during Lin Yuan’s return to the capital, he would suddenly ‘disappear’ and find another place for intense cultivation.

Anyway, with his current strength, he could come and go freely across the major domains nearby, and even the surrounding ancient countries.

“As for your identity…”

Lord Qingfen pondered, “Your identity as a core royal must not be exposed.”

A core royal with an extremely rich Fierce Sun bloodline, if not hiding in the capital, would inevitably face assassination attempts from surrounding ancient countries, and even strong individuals at the level of Heavenly Venerate might take action.

“I will claim that you are a disciple I took many years ago, but have been cultivating outside, and I only brought you back recently after you stepped into the realm of the Great Lord.”

Lord Qingfen said.

This explanation is quite reasonable. Lord Qingfen occasionally roams the Qingfen Domain, and upon passing by the Yu Family, noticed Lin Yuan’s gifted aptitude, so he secretly accepted him as a disciple.

As for the time discrepancy? Yu Yan is less than five hundred years old?

A Great Lord level expert can undoubtedly open a small world and then accelerate the flow of time, with rules fluctuating similar to the outside world.

In such a small world, many rules can be mirrored from the outside, and there are indeed some peculiar and perilous lands within the vast Fierce Sun Ancient Country where time flows quickly.

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The main reason is that he has demonstrated Great Lord level combat power. Even if Lord Qingfen tries to suppress it, the Purple Dream Domain would likely investigate Lin Yuan’s identity.

Under such circumstances, it’s better to proactively craft an identity for Lin Yuan.

…

Following this, Lord Qingfen gave a few more words of advice before getting up to leave.

Inside the Sky Burning Court.

Lin Yuan fell into contemplation.

“The core royal family of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

It’s said that beings whose bloodline concentration reaches the level of the core royal, possess unrivaled combat power, with the potential to defeat Great Lords while in the Dominator realm.

This is also the reason why Lord Qingfen concluded that Lin Yuan’s Fierce Sun bloodline was extremely rich.

Besides the core royal family, who else could wield Great Lord level power without having reached that realm?

“Is this the Thirteenth Level Bloodline?”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head, quite amazed.

A Dominator counter-slaying a Great Lord is akin to, in the Chaos Void, a Dominator standing alongside a Chaos Venerable.

At least until now, Lin Yuan hadn’t heard of such a thing happening.

But in this source world, there indeed seems to be evidence of such phenomenon.

“However, I am not a Dominator.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. His true realm is the Path Splitting Realm.

Path Splitting counter-slaying a Great Lord? Even with a Thirteenth Level Bloodline, it would be impossible.

…

As Qingfen City gradually settled down.

Information about Lin Yuan started circulating rapidly.

Outside the Sky Burning Court, Lin Yuan erupted with Great Lord level power, instantly overwhelming and killing the infiltrating powers of the Purple Dream Domain, foiling the Purple Dream Domain’s plans, and even shattered an incarnation of Marquis Purple Dream.

The impact of this news on the various factions and families of the Qingfen Domain was imaginable.

“This, this, this…” Lord Qingfen’s disciples were the first to receive this news, immediately feeling somewhat bewildered.

Was their youngest junior disciple actually a Great Lord?

“Senior Brother, is this true?”

A disciple immediately sought out Senior Brother Feng Wanxing for confirmation.

“Of course it’s true, I saw it with my own eyes.” Feng Wanxing nodded.

Initially, he had his doubts, but after hearing Lord Qingfen’s explanation, it all became clear to him.

No wonder Lord Qingfen personally brought the youngest junior disciple back, as he had accepted him as a disciple many years ago.

“From now on, don’t call me Senior Brother anymore.” Feng Wanxing thought for a moment and immediately instructed.

Among Lord Qingfen’s disciples, power was respected. Even if they didn’t know before, now that they knew Lin Yuan was a Great Lord…

Feng Wanxing no longer dared to let others continue calling him Senior Brother.
